sources.title: Political Leanings of Major AI Models Examined
sources.snippet: So why do AI systems built by competing companies, with different teams, different goals, and different marketing strategies, all end up in roughly the same political neighborhood? Two leading theories have emerged. sources.snippet: An AI model, Claude, produced the first end-to-end, computer-checked proof of Fermat's Last Theorem (FLT). Working largely autonomously over 11 days, Claude generated 13 million lines of Lean code and proved 29,500 intermediate theorems, following a simplified version of Wiles's proof.
